prompt: Which computes the mean squared error between predictions and actual values?
choices: double mse = 0; for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) { double diff = predictions[i] - actuals[i]; mse += diff * diff; } mse /= n;
explanation: MSE = (1/n) * Σ(predicted - actual)². Loop over all n samples, accumulate squared differences, divide by n. Option A divides sums (not MSE). Option C only checks one element. Option D computes mean of predictions, not mean error.
